title: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an authenticated user with the Reader…
description: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty versions 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 contain a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user with the Reader role to access sensitive information. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.3. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
